description: Renew the authorization of an organization connector that signs in to a provider in a browser, either an OAuth connector or a Composio-managed one, for a connector whose grant the provider revoked or whose first authorization never finished. This tool does not return the provider's address. Say plainly in reason why the sign-in is needed. The answer carries a request whose url the person opens, signed in to Valet, to sign in to the provider from there; give the person the url, then follow the request with get_request. The connector keeps its name and configuration, and only new tokens are issued. A repeat by the same person returns the same pending request. The request completes only after a new consent for an OAuth connector; for a managed toolkit an active connection is reused. A connector whose credential is a secret is refused, and the answer names the secrets to set with set_env_vars. A Composio toolkit that takes an API key hands off to the Integrations page. Requires connecting a Valet account.

connector.description: The connector's name in the organization.

org_name.description: The Valet organization the connector belongs to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

reason.description: Needed when the connector signs in to a provider. One plain sentence, shown to the person on the request page, saying why the value is needed, such as: The app charges cards and needs your Stripe key.

name: reauthorize_connector

connector.description: Name of the connector to reauthorize.

org.description: Name of the Valet organization the call acted in.

request.description: The request a person completes in the dashboard to enter a value that must not pass through this conversation. Absent when nothing needs a person.

expires_at.description: When the request expires unanswered, as an RFC 3339 UTC time.

fields.description: Names of what the person enters, never values.

id.description: Id of the request. Pass it to get_request to follow the request.

next_step.description: What to do next: give the person the url, then follow the request with get_request.

url.description: Dashboard page to give the person. They open it signed in to Valet to complete the request. It holds no credential.

secrets.description: Names of the secrets a secret-credential connector reads.

step.description: What the person does on the Integrations page, for a Composio toolkit that takes an API key. Absent otherwise.

url.description: The Integrations page the person opens. It holds no credential. Absent unless step is set.

title: Reauthorize a connector
